rationale: The papers by Brack (2023), the spectro-interferometric analysis of $	ext{omicron}$ Aquarii (2020), and the study on disk tearing and precession (2022) provide insights into the physical and dynamic structures of the circumstellar envelope, contributing evidence relevant to the origin of the gaseous disk envelope surrounding Be stars.
